profile.headline: Developing Workflow Solutions at GDIT
profile.summary: Over 20 years of experience with ITSM tools including HP ServiceManager (formerly Peregrine ServiceCenter) and ServiceNow as Systems Administrator,  Application Developer and IT Team Manager.  Able to provide exceptional tracking and level of detail to technical coding standards and best practice frameworks.  Can analyze complex concepts or problems then provide technical solutions.  Excel in understanding and interpreting academic and theoretical concepts, and then applying them in a practical manner.  Can communicate concepts effectively through all levels, from technical personnel, end users to senior management.

positions.title: Master Platform Engineer
positions.description: Senior developer focusing on ITSM tools development at Capital One. Developing new capability for strategic business initiatives. Creating and maintaining the integration with multiple IT divisions

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Consultant specializing in design, configuration, implementation and support of the HP Openview ServiceManager and related products.

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description: Senior Systems Developer and Administrator developing Peregrine ServiceCenter Interaction, Incident and Problem management. Developed integrations with paging and notification systems to receive high priority outage alerts.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Developed a problem management solution for the FAA consolidating 3 existing systems by customizing HP ServiceCenter and Syclo Agentry. The application being designed to support 6000 FAA employees and field technicians.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Lead Developer and administrator for call and incident management using HP ServiceCenter. Developed supporting UNIX shell scripts to support the application server. Wrote documentation and organized training programs for system users and administrators.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology with a Concentration in Software Engineering
